name: lwa-mcp
description: Local-first Lwa MCP router, consent gate, persistent tool library, workflow observer, and dashboard for every Codex conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-conversation model routing and workflow tools.
interface.longDescription: Exposes the complete Lwa MCP server through Codex: governed model routing, consent and quota preflight, persistent tool-library discovery and execution, workflow observation, SITREPs, planning, consensus, verification, compression, prompt optimization, document editing, and the local dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this task through Lwa MCP and show the locked route.
Use the persistent tool library when a matching workflow exists.
Create a SITREP and next work order with evidence.
